title: Proto-cleanup discipline -- incidents + history (ref)
desc: T3 ref tier of proto-cleanup-discipline: dated incidents behind the proto-suffix discipline, the dead-script detector, the unguarded-CI audit, and the env-backdoor removals. Consult for WHY a rule exists.
steps: ORIGIN: the proto/-prove/-probe/-model suffix discipline (keep <=2 unconnected per folder, ROOT-deletes-never-an-agent, connect-verified-logic-to-canonical BEFORE removing) came from repeated sandbox-junk accumulation; ROOT git-cleaned ~105 dead -proto.ps1 in one pass (the pace-exempt git method for gitignored protos). The standing rule: clean junk BEFORE delegating, and a cheap intel prototypes into a -proto/-probe sandbox while ROOT promotes the canonical.
author: claude
